title: Perform service delivery system planning
goal: The venture knows what its delivery system must carry next quarter: every part each live offer runs on is listed with its owner, the load the agreed forecast puts on it is stated, and each gap carries its cost and the week it is first needed.

steps.do: List every part delivery runs on for each live offer (the tools and licences, the accounts and access, the environments, the templates, the data the client supplies) with who owns it, taking what is already recorded from the venture's connection and asset records and marking the rest as unrecorded.

From the agreed forecast and the active engagements, say how many engagements run at once in each of the next thirteen weeks and what that asks of each part: seats, storage, supplier lead time and the founder's attention.

Name each part that is missing, at its limit or held by a single supplier, with what it would cost, how long it takes to put in place and the week it is first needed, and bring any purchase or commitment to the founder as a decision.
Add the gaps to the decisions they bear on as evidence, and recommend to the product lead which part to put in place first and which load to refuse instead.

done_criteria.check: Is every part each live offer's delivery depends on listed with its owner, and does each gap name its cost and the week it is first needed?
